'''Brejjan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. As of [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in the Imperial Fleet, where he served the Empire as a vendor and merchant.

==Behind the scenes==
Private Brejjan appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Corellia Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock, though he was later relabeled as the Level 50 Equipment Vendor. He was later removed from the game along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Commendations vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
